facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/fobj:.bss
facts.value: During HSD object-system startup, HSD_FObjInitAllocData passes this descriptor, sizeof(HSD_FObj), and alignment 4 to HSD_ObjAllocInit. Initialization clears and registers the descriptor and derives its aligned object size. HSD_FObjAlloc consumes it to obtain zeroed FObjs, HSD_FObjFree returns FObjs through it, and HSD_ObjDumpStat reads its used, free, and peak counters under the label "fobj".

facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/fobj:.bss
facts.value: Its meaningful payload is one HSD_ObjAllocData object. This 0x2C-byte descriptor contains allocation-limit flags, a free-list head, used/free/peak counters, numeric and heap limits, aligned object size, alignment mask, and a link to the next registered allocator descriptor.

facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/fobj:.bss
facts.value: Provides the persistent allocator descriptor for HSD_FObj instances, allowing the common HSD object allocator to manage the FObj free list, allocation limits, object size and alignment, and usage statistics.

facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/fobj:.bss
facts.value: The descriptor begins as zero-initialized BSS storage. Initialization removes prior registry links to it, clears it, installs unlimited default allocation limits, sets an alignment mask of 3 and an aligned HSD_FObj stride, and registers it at the head of the allocator list. Allocation removes an entry from its free list, increments used, decrements free, and raises peak when necessary; freeing performs the inverse counter transition and prepends the released object to the free list.

facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/fobj:.data
facts.value: The tables are read-only dispatch inputs. FObjLoadData selects a value or slope loader from the packed stream's decoded opcode; FObjUpdateAnim selects discrete, constant, linear, or Hermite evaluation from op_intrp; and HSD_FObjInterpretAnim dispatches playback among data loading, wait loading, interpolation, boundary processing, and terminal-key completion according to interpreter state.

facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/fobj:.data
facts.value: A 72-byte initialized-data region laid out as three six-entry tables of 32-bit code addresses. The tables correspond to six animation-operation cases used while loading data, six operation cases used while evaluating output, and six active interpreter-state cases.

facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/fobj:.data
facts.value: Stores compiler-emitted jump tables that dispatch FObj animation processing by packed animation opcode, active interpolation opcode, and interpreter state; it is control-flow support data rather than an authored animation-data object.

facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/fobj:.sdata
facts.value: parseFloat masks the packed format byte with 0xE0 and uses the resulting representation class to select an entry in this table. Control transfers to a decoder that reads one or two bytes from the animation stream with the selected signedness, advances the stream cursor by that width, and then scales the integer by the binary fractional count encoded in the format byte's low five bits.

facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/fobj:.sdata
facts.value: A compiler-generated jump table consisting of four 32-bit code-address entries, one for each recognized fixed-point representation class selected by frac & 0xE0.

facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/fobj:.sdata
facts.value: Holds the compiler-generated branch table used by parseFloat to dispatch packed fixed-point animation values to signed 8-bit, unsigned 8-bit, signed 16-bit, or unsigned 16-bit decoding paths.

facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/fobj:.sdata2
facts.value: Constants from this pool enter FObj processing when animation requests zero interpolation state and form floating-point start times, when parseFloat converts packed signed or unsigned values and divides them by a power-of-two scale, and when FObjUpdateAnim supplies zero fallbacks or normalizes Hermite duration with one. The resulting values become channel endpoints, slopes, times, and interpolated HSD_ObjData delivered through the destination update callback.

facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/fobj:.sdata2
facts.value: A read-only small-data pool of scalar floating-point literals, including canonical zero and one values and compiler-emitted support constants needed for integer-to-floating conversion paths; it is not mutable state or a structured animation descriptor table.

facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/fobj:.sdata2
facts.value: Provides the FObj translation unit's read-only floating-point literal pool for animation-state initialization, packed numeric decoding, interpolation evaluation, and playback-time comparisons.

facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/fobj:FObjLaunchKeyData
facts.value: Implements the commit step for discrete property keyframes in HSD scene-animation playback, ensuring each buffered step value becomes eligible for one callback update and that the final buffered value is applied when its animation-data stream ends.
facts.reason: Unqualified final callback or numeric range claim needs valid stream/callback/compiler preconditions. Final key delivery is conditional; signed denominator shift31 and unbounded packed shifts need machine evidence.

facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/fobj:parseFloat
facts.value: For HSD_A_FRAC_FLOAT, the routine consumes four bytes in little-endian order, assembles them into a u32, and reinterprets that bit pattern as f32. For fixed-point formats, it reads a signed or unsigned one- or two-byte little-endian integer, advances the input cursor by that width, and returns the integer divided by 2 raised to the low-five-bit fractional count. An unrecognized representation returns 0.0 without advancing the cursor.

facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/fobj:parsePackInfo
facts.value: A cursor-consuming packed-count decoder with signature u32(u8** adp). Its input is an in/out pointer into an HSD_FObj animation byte stream, and its result is an unsigned run length in the range 1 through the representable variable-length encoding.
